t: You're looking at Highpoint II, an apartment building in Highgate. It was designed by Berthold Lubetkin, the Russian-born British architect who pioneered modernist design in Britain in the 1930s. Lubetkin's name is tied to the Highpoint housing complex, and this building belongs to that story. His other work includes the Penguin Pool at London Zoo, Finsbury Health Centre and Spa Green Estate. So Highgate holds an important piece of British modernism, by the same hand as those better-known landmarks.
